verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a government tax self-service portal, so the axis applies. However, none of the documented Online Services features mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to an agent. Those features are payments, responding to notices, filing via Web File, authorized-representative access, calculators and lookups, and the 'we'll walk you through the process' line describes a guided form flow, not an AI assistant. Confidence is medium rather than high because the robots-disallowed /e-services/ account surface was never fetched, so any in-account assistant would not have been observed.
